messages:
aj: CI failing on infra repo — gha job 'provision-gpu-pool' keeps timing out, runner shows disk full during cache restore. https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions/runs/123456789
ci-bot: Job failed: cache restore timed out (s3). Logs: "tar: write error: No space left on device"
maria: hitting same on my rerun. ephemeral runner /tmp at 0% free after cache extract
aj: repro locally by spinning up the runner image and applying the same cache tar — looks like cleanup didn't run after previous job
aj: @infra-oncall can you check runner pool quota and recent changes to runner image?
infra-oncall: Investigating. Autoscaler created ephemeral runners with 20Gi root by default. GPU jobs with wheelhouse + model artifacts easily need ~25–30Gi. Bumping to 40Gi for gpu labels now, will monitor.
samir: note: terraform apply hung too — helm chart upload failed with 502 after cache step because certs couldn't be written to disk (I/O errors in logs)
olivia: quick workaround: skip heavy cache for repro runs. set an env var in the workflow: 
```yaml
- name: Skip cache for debug
  run: echo "CACHE=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
```
maria: good call. Also seeing workflow concurrency collisions when multiple infra workflows request the same runner label. They race for the cache restore and push disk over the limit
aj: can we add an early precheck step to fail fast if /tmp < 2Gi so long-running steps don't start?
infra-oncall: adding precheck step to hotfix branch now. Also adjusting concurrency settings on the workflow to use a dedicated group for infra-gpu jobs
samir: pinging cloud infra to audit recent image layers — a new python wheel got added to the wheelhouse and inflated image size by ~300MB which exacerbates the restore burst
ci-bot: Rerun started by @aj: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions/runs/123456790
aj: rerun succeeded after bumping ephemeral volume to 40Gi and skipping cache for that run :thumbsup:
olivia: follow-up proposal: set default ephemeral runner root to 50Gi for labels with [gpu,large-io] and add a sanity check step in our infra workflows. Also add an alert on runner host for /tmp < 10%
aj: filed TICKET-4824 with logs, repro steps, and suggested fixes (volumes + precheck + concurrency tweak)
infra-oncall: hotfix merged to workflows, autoscaler updated to 40Gi for gpu labels, monitoring alert created. Closing loop unless someone sees more failures :white_check_mark:
